The terms permit customer applications but prohibit reverse engineering, extracting, or replicating model components such as parameter weights, so nothing is licensed for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Access to Gemini 3 Pro Preview through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, including the incorporated Google APIs Terms of Service and Prohibited Use Policy; no weight license

access_boundary: This record represents the preview release identified by the undated model code gemini-3-pro-preview (latest update November 2025; knowledge cutoff January 2025; inputs text, image, video, audio, PDF; output text). Google shut the preview endpoint down on March 9, 2026 and names gemini-3.1-pro-preview as the replacement; there is no dated snapshot behind the ID. The successor preview, Gemini 3 Flash Preview, the image-generation releases, the Gemini consumer app, and the Vertex AI and AI Studio platforms themselves are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a distinct model code, full modality matrix, token limits, release date, and an explicit shutdown with a named replacement
A DeepMind Gemini 3 Pro model card corroborates identity, multimodal scope, knowledge cutoff, and prohibited-use applicability
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The preview endpoint is shut down after a four-month service life, so the record documents a retired release and its replacement
